newsitem.title: USA: FGIC qualifies seven issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FGIC qualifies seven issues for bond insurance.

text.p: FGIC said it has qualified for bond insurance the following municipal seven issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--New Orleans, La., $50 million of public improvement bonds.
--Clarence CSD, N.Y., $20.9 million of GO school bonds.
--Katonah-Lewisboro SD, N.Y., $4.3 million of school district bonds.
--Lakeland CSD, N.Y., $5.6 million of school bonds.
--Canon McMillan SD, Pa., $5 million of GO bonds.
--Robertson County, Tenn., $6.6 million of GO school bonds.
--Newport News, Va., $28 million of GO bonds and $28 million of water bonds. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
